turns.speaker: Steve
turns.text: Ah, Samantha, it's great to have you on board! The dark energies in "The Cursed Ritual" are a blend of ancient magic and modern psychological manipulation. The NPCs are driven by a mix of fear, curiosity, and a deep-seated need to belong. Their behaviors will evolve based on their interactions with you—will they be drawn to you or driven away? It's all about creating that eerie, unpredictable atmosphere that keeps players on edge.
